summary: Measured post-Gen461 Web Agent tree hotspot: one coalesced builder still replays large parent logs for settlement display. Reuse bounded segment projections; do not change collection authority or restart production.

components.owning_subsystem: Existing EventStore segment projection, SubAgentDeliveryJournal and Web Agent tree.
components.disposition: Reuse stable segment identity stamps and bounded caches; decode only subagent_result receipt/commit rows, fold exact child/parent/generation/result binding and commit order. Separate display cache from authoritative settlement; Web projection cannot set handle.collected. Canonical read fallback for unstable/unknown layouts.
evidence: Two production stack samples after Gen461 show one builder in topology_snapshot -> settlement_committed -> EventStore.read_cached -> read -> _parse_line. Agent tree timeout at 8s under natural workload.

Final directed regression 80 passed including architecture ratchet; Ruff and diffcheck PASS. Tests cover escaped tool name, cross-segment receipt/commit, append, same-tail replacement, deletion, no full parent replay and no display collection mutation.

Synthetic 41.7MB/5002 events: two decoded rows, 537 retained bytes; 1/4/8 concurrent readers cold max 46.6/46.85/47.09ms vs canonical cold 41.7ms; warm 0.11–0.15ms; append 9.11–9.27ms. No real Run or production latency claim.
Read-only inactive real 79.28MB/45679 events: full fold 357.24ms vs display 163.98ms, equal empty binding sets. Positive binding equivalence covered by synthetic regression.

First original R9 stopped at Pyright (6 new and 3 historical touched-file diagnostics); explicit callable signatures and sequence typing corrected without changing runtime behavior or diagnostic baselines. Final targeted Pyright two files 0 errors, 0 warnings; 80 directed regressions passed again.
